title: Isandro and the Songbook
author: Silas Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Halloran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
